title: 46. How do I ensure that a user does not submit more than a defined number of contributions to my survey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I ensure that a user does not submit more than a defined number of contributions to my survey.
short_answer: To ensure that an user does not submit more than a defined number of contributions to your survey, in the 'Properties' page enable the options 'Secure your survey' and 'Secure with EU Login' and set the number in the 'Contributions per user' option.
